statements.t: Strong commercial uptake has driven sequential revenue growth and positive cash flow ahead of guidance, putting us well on our way to realizing its blockbuster potential.

We previously guided to positive cash flow by the end of the year, and we are pleased to have achieved it a full quarter ahead of that guidance, with net cash provided by operating activities of $11.9 million.

These results are particularly remarkable given that PAPZIMEOS launched just one year ago, and we expect continued revenue momentum as adoption grows while we maintain our focus on fiscal responsibility.”

The increase in warrant liabilities was mainly driven by a rise in the Company's common stock price and, to a lesser extent, by an increase in the liability for additional warrants that were expected at that point to be issued as paid-in-kind dividends on the Company’s then outstanding Series A Preferred Stock.

We are leveraging our proprietary technology platforms to develop product candidates designed to target urgent and intractable diseases in our core therapeutic areas of immuno-oncology, autoimmune disorders, and infectious diseases.
We estimate that there are approximately 27,000 adult patients in the United States living with RRP.

PRGN-2009, an investigational non-replicating adenoviral vector-based immunotherapy, based on our AdenoVerse platform, is designed to activate the immune system to recognize and target human papillomavirus-positive, or HPV+, solid tumors.

Guided by our bioinformatics analysis and in silico protein engineering, PRGN-2009 encodes for a novel, multi-epitope antigen design to target HPV16 and HPV18 infected cells and potentially differentiates from the competition.
PRGN-3006 is an investigational autologous CAR-T therapy that utilizes our UltraCAR-T platform to express a CAR to target CD33 (Siglec-3), mbIL15 and a kill switch gene.

PRGN-3005 is an investigational autologous CAR-T therapy that utilizes our UltraCAR-T platform to simultaneously express a CAR targeting the unshed portion of the Mucin 16 antigen, mbIL15, and kill switch genes.

Looking ahead, we expect that the majority of our future revenues for the foreseeable future will be derived from sales of Papzimeos as we continue to expand our commercial activities and market presence.
In 2025, revenues generated by Exemplar became less significant to us, and we expect this significance to greatly diminish into the future.
We do not anticipate that we will be recognizing material collaboration revenue in the near term, except in cases of future strategic transactions involving our platforms, products and programs.

As a result, we expect cost of products for Papzimeos in future periods, excluding any significant period costs, to primarily reflect inventory capitalized at full production cost, and therefore to increase (exclusive of period costs) as a percentage of Papzimeos product revenue compared with periods in which pre-launch inventory was sold.
Additionally, we plan to initiate a clinical trial to evaluate safety and efficacy of zopapogene imadenovec-drba in pediatric RRP patients.

The prior-year increase in warrant liabilities was mainly driven by a rise in Precigen’s stock price and, to a lesser extent, by an increase in the liability for additional warrants that were expected at that point to be issued as paid-in-kind dividends on the Company’s then outstanding Series A Preferred Stock.

Until such time, if ever, as we can regularly generate positive operating cash flows, we plan to finance our cash needs through a combination of collection of accounts receivable from the sale of Papzimeos, debt and/or royalty financings, equity offerings, government, or other third-party funding, strategic alliances, sales of assets, and licensing arrangements.

To the extent that we raise additional capital through the sale of equity, convertible debt, warrants or preferred securities, the ownership interests of our common shareholders will be diluted, and the terms of these securities may include liquidation or other preferences that adversely affect the rights of our common shareholders.

Our condensed consolidated financial statements as of September 30, 2026 have been prepared on the basis that we will continue as a going concern, which contemplates the realization of assets and satisfaction of liabilities in the normal course of business.

Based on current projections, management believes that its existing cash, cash equivalents and short and long-term investments, combined with anticipated collection of accounts receivable from the commercialization of Papzimeos (including future sales), will enable us to continue our operations for at least one year from the date of this filing.
